{{Quote|Listening to Tendau Bendon morosely drone on about the mourning fig trees of some forsaken world made me want to me to take someone's life (my own is far too fabulous to even ''contemplate'' taking!).|[[Dyslogia Twang]]|<ref name="HNN53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|life/13425_1.html|SPECIAL FEATURE: Sightings by Twang}}</ref>}}
An unidentified '''planet''' had [[fig tree]]s in its native [[Plant/Legends|flora]]. In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was mostly forgotten, and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]] took interest in the preservation of its "mourning" fig trees.
